title: EvidenceAudit
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Claim-level evidence audit. Each important claim should be traceable to specific evidence with an explicit support level, uncertainty hook, and risk-if-wrong note. This schema is not yet wired into the CLI `audit` command by default; it is published so agents and downstream tooling can adopt the contract.

unsupported_claims.description: Important claims the analyst could not back with evidence.

claim_type.description: Free-form taxonomy label (e.g. regulatory_change, sanctions_event, market_event, geopolitical_event, capability_claim).

uncertainty.description: What the analyst is unsure about, even if the claim is supported.

risk_if_wrong.description: Decision-level cost if this claim turns out to be wrong.

source_type.description: e.g. official_document, regulator_announcement, news, analyst_report, primary_data, illustrative_placeholder.
